act_breaks.act_1_end: Inciting incident locks protagonist into survival situation (~25-30% runtime).
act_breaks.midpoint: Moral-fact reveal re-reads first half (~50% runtime).

shot_discipline.establishing_shot_per_scene: 1 wide for geography, then close-ups and inserts.
shot_discipline.montage_for_repetition: Time passing (days) is montage, not repeated scenes.
shot_discipline.no_static_slideshow: Each shot must have motion design (push-in, pan, parallax) even if image is still.

narration_discipline.voice_over_per_scene: 1-3 sentences per shot, 80-150 words per scene.
narration_discipline.avoid_describing_visible: Narration should add interior, not narrate visible action.
narration_discipline.withhold_through_narration: Narrator can be wrong; reveal via image later.
